base.sampling_caveat: Control extras use frames 5,25,...485. Learned-policy extras use 25 unique evenly spaced candidates per episode from positive multiples of 5, including the first and last candidate. Early deaths prevent matching the frame stride. The comparison changes visited states and within-episode sampling density; it does not isolate those effects. Neither arm pads or repeats candidate row indices; exact input overlap with the base is retained and reported.

base_extra_overlap.definition: SHA256 over oracle label and every encoded entity array, excluding seed/frame; identifier overlap is reported separately. Duplicate rows are retained without reselection.

inputs.roles: original stationary collector regenerates fixed states; old moving teacher supplies reproduction tensors only

interpretation: A single-initialization fixed-data fit-budget diagnostic. Training fit, held-out imitation and closed-loop survival are separate results; thresholds are exploratory, not qualification criteria. No PPO, student collection or architecture changes follow automatically.

reproduction.comparison: tensor values and optimizer tree; new checkpoint file bytes need not match historical metadata

resource_checks: cooperative before/after operations; calls are not preempted; retention may run after a cap
